mapping_note: This baseline is the knowledge-management iter-11 LEGACY-weights composite. It is NOT a per-Kasten baseline for psychedelic-drugs / economics — those have no prior run. It is carried as the reference target so iter-1 of each v2 Kasten is scored against the same composite definition the v1 loop converged on. The mapping is NOT 1:1: the corpus, query set, and member set differ entirely. Treat composite=60.26 as the 'pipeline-quality bar to beat', not an expected score for this Kasten. compare_baseline.py reports delta vs this and also reports the trust-first holistic block (gold@1 / accuracy_user_visible / over_refusal) so improvement is not judged on the legacy composite alone.
